stages.discovery: A leaning cabin sits back from the road, its door hanging ajar. A steady scratching and squeaking carries from inside - something has moved in since the last tenant left.

choices.label: Push the Door Open
choices.description: Go in and see what's nesting there

choices.label: Peer Through the Window
choices.description: Take a look before committing - Perception check

check.success_outcome: Through the grimy glass you count several oversized rats tearing through what's left of the pantry.
check.failure_outcome: The glass is too grimed over to see much of anything inside - just shifting shadows and the sound of gnawing.

choices.label: Leave It
choices.description: ESC also cancels - not worth the bother

stages.ignore: You leave the cabin and its new tenants to themselves and continue down the road.

stages.discovery: Inside, the floorboards are gnawed through and the pantry is in ruins. A nest of giant rats scatters at the sound of your footsteps, then turns to bare its teeth.
stages.sneak_success: You keep to the doorway and count the nest without waking it, then back out the way you came.
stages.sneak_fail: A floorboard creaks underfoot and the whole nest turns on you at once.
stages.ignore: You back out of the cabin and leave the rats to their ruined pantry.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Wade in and clear the nest

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Try to get a look without disturbing them

choices.label: Leave It
choices.description: ESC also cancels - just back out
